Players Committee card image of [[Imperial Code Cylinder (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Take Krennic or a non-spy captain into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Peek at the bottom card of any deck or pile. OR During the power segment of a battle, if your captain in battle with your leader, cancel one destiny just drawn (except a battle destiny).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Imperial%20Code%20Cylinder.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Imperial Code Cylinder.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
